Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer made a critical logic error in the implementation of the Cocktail Shaker Sort algorithm. Specifically, the `swapped` flag was reset to `False` at the beginning of the `while` loop, but then immediately set to `False` again after the forward pass (line: `swapped = False` after the forward pass loop). This caused the backward pass to always execute regardless of whether any swaps occurred in the forward pass, breaking the optimization logic of the algorithm. The correct implementation should only reset `swapped` to `False` after checking if the array is already sorted (i.e., after the forward pass if no swaps occurred), not unconditionally at the start of each iteration. This error is similar to Example 1 (Case #119) where a boundary condition or flag logic was incorrectly implemented, leading to suboptimal or incorrect behavior.
